name: Bedrock uniBTC vault native mint without price conversion
summary: The uniBTC Vault's payable mint() minted one uniBTC per whole native coin, a rate only sound on BTC-gas chains. The upgrade that activated this code replaced the balance-based cap check with a supply-feeder total that returned 0 for NATIVE_BTC, so native mints passed on ETH chains. Attackers minted uniBTC 1:1 for ETH or BNB and sold it into uniBTC pools.

notes: The campaign is every native-BTC Minted event on the uniBTC vaults of Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Mantle and BOB until each was paused; Mode and ZetaChain vaults show none. The Ethereum anchor is the earliest.

Loss is the BTC-side outflow of the uniBTC pools (uniBTC/WBTC on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Optimism; uniBTC/BTCB on BNB Chain) in the mint transactions and in later transfers of the freshly minted uniBTC, measured from receipts and priced per transaction.

Not counted: the ETH and BNB paid into the vaults (stays with Bedrock), unsold uniBTC, and about 2 uniBTC bridged to zkLink Nova whose sale was not traced. The Ethereum pool was emptied by the anchor, so later Ethereum sales add almost nothing.
